wikidot5e:spell:aura-of-purity.effectSummary: A 30-foot-radius aura moves with you. Each nonhostile creature in it, including you, cannot become diseased, has resistance to poison damage, and has advantage on saving throws against effects that would blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun it.

wikidot5e:spell:awaken.effectSummary: Touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant whose Intelligence is absent or 3 or lower. It gains Intelligence 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. An awakened plant also gains movement with its plant parts and humanlike senses; the DM chooses suitable game statistics. The awakened target is charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your companions harm it. When that charm ends, the creature decides whether to remain friendly based on how you treated it.

wikidot5e:spell:bane.effectSummary: Up to three creatures you can see within range make Charisma saves. A target that fails must subtract 1d4 whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends. Each slot level above 1st lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:banishing-smite.effectSummary: The next weapon attack you hit with before the spell ends deals an extra 5d10 force damage. If that attack leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer, it is banished. A creature native to another plane returns to its home plane. A creature native to the current plane instead goes to a harmless demiplane where it is incapacitated; when the spell ends it returns to its former space or the nearest unoccupied space if necessary.

wikidot5e:spell:banishment.effectSummary: One creature you can see in range makes a Charisma save or is banished. A creature native to the current plane is sent to a harmless demiplane and incapacitated until the spell ends, then returns to its former space or the nearest unoccupied space. A creature native to another plane returns to its home plane; if the spell ends before 1 minute it returns as above, but if concentration lasts the full minute it does not return. Each slot level above 4th lets you target one additional creature.

wikidot5e:spell:beast-bond.effectSummary: Touch one beast that is friendly to or charmed by you; the spell fails if its Intelligence is 4 or higher. While you and the beast remain within line of sight, you can send it telepathic messages it understands and it can send simple emotions and concepts back. While the link is active, the beast has advantage on attacks against creatures that are within 5 feet of you and that you can see.

wikidot5e:spell:bestow-curse.effectSummary: A creature you touch makes a Wisdom save or is cursed. Choose one effect: disadvantage on checks and saves with one chosen ability; disadvantage on attacks against you; at the start of each turn, a Wisdom save that causes the target to waste its action on a failure; or your attacks and spells deal an extra 1d8 necrotic damage to it. Remove curse ends the effect. With DM approval, you may use a different curse no stronger than these options. A 4th-level slot changes the duration to concentration up to 10 minutes; 5th or 6th lasts 8 hours, 7th or 8th lasts 24 hours, and 9th lasts until dispelled. Durations from a 5th-level-or-higher slot do not require concentration.

wikidot5e:spell:bigbys-hand.effectSummary: Create a Large force hand in an unoccupied space in range. It is an object with AC 20, HP equal to your maximum HP, Str 26 (+8), Dex 10 (+0), does not fill its space, and ends the spell at 0 HP. On casting and as a bonus action on later turns, move it up to 60 feet and choose one effect. Clenched Fist: make a melee spell attack against a creature or object within 5 feet; a hit deals 4d8 force. Forceful Hand: contest the hand's Strength against a creature's Athletics within 5 feet, with advantage against Medium or smaller targets; on success push it up to 5 feet plus 5 times your spellcasting ability modifier, with the hand following within 5 feet. Grasping Hand: grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet using the hand's Strength, with advantage against Medium or smaller targets; while grappling, a bonus action crush deals 2d6 plus your spellcasting ability modifier bludgeoning damage. Interposing Hand: it stays between you and a chosen creature, giving you half cover; a target with Strength no greater than 26 cannot move through its space, while a stronger target can but treats that space as difficult terrain. Each slot level above 5th adds 2d8 to Clenched Fist and 2d6 to Grasping Hand damage.

wikidot5e:spell:blade-barrier.effectSummary: Create either a straight vertical wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ring up to 60 feet in diameter with the same height and thickness. The wall gives three-quarters cover to creatures behind it and its space is difficult terrain. A creature entering the wall's area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 slashing damage on a failure or half on a success.

wikidot5e:spell:blade-of-disaster.effectSummary: Create a roughly 3-foot planar-rift blade in an unoccupied space you can see in range. On casting, make up to two melee spell attacks with it against creatures, loose objects, or structures within 5 feet. Each hit deals 4d12 force damage. The attack critically hits on a d20 roll of 18–20; a critical adds 8d12 force damage, for 12d12 total. As a bonus action on your turn, move the blade up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space and make up to two attacks again. The blade can pass harmlessly through any barrier, including wall of force.
